title: Farnell expands rugged connectivity portfolio with TE Connectivity’s DEUTSCH range
body_markdown:
[View All News](https://news.avnet.com/press-releases/avnet-press-releases/default.aspx)


## Farnell expands rugged connectivity portfolio with TE Connectivity’s DEUTSCH range


November 17, 2026


[Inline Presspage (1723 x 1391 px) (24)](https://news.avnet.com/files/images/farnell/1920_inlinepresspage1723x1391px24.png)


*New agreement gives European customers access to TE Connectivity’s established DEUTSCH connectors and contacts for transportation and industrial markets*


Farnell, a leading high-service distributor of products and technology solutions for electronic and industrial system design, has been appointed an authorised distributor for TE Connectivity’s DEUTSCH connector and contact portfolio in Europe. The agreement expands Farnell’s interconnect offering with a range of rugged connectivity solutions designed to deliver reliable electrical performance in demanding environments.


The portfolio gives engineers and manufacturers across Europe access to DEUTSCH connectors and contacts for demanding applications, including agricultural and construction equipment, trucks, buses, recreational vehicles, marine and other off-road vehicles.


DEUTSCH connector and contact solutions are engineered for environments where equipment can be exposed to vibration, moisture, dust, mechanical shock and temperature extremes. The portfolio spans compact, low-power, and signal connections through to higher-current power applications, giving designers flexible connectivity options across a wide range of equipment architectures.


The portfolio includes established DEUTSCH connector and contact product families such as DT, DTM, DTP, HD10, HD30 and HDP20, together with solid and stamped-and-formed contacts. While widely used in transportation and off-road applications, the rugged characteristics of DEUTSCH connectivity also make the portfolio relevant to adjacent industrial applications including automation, control and robotics.


“Farnell is excited to partner with TE Connectivity on this well-established and highly regarded part of its interconnect portfolio,” said **Tony Coletto, VP Supplier Management, at Farnell** .


“DEUTSCH connector and contact products are recognised for delivering high-quality connectivity solutions for demanding applications, and adding the portfolio to our offering gives customers another convenient source for field-proven rugged interconnect technology. We are looking forward to working with TE Connectivity to explore new opportunities across transportation and industrial markets.”


“TE Connectivity is pleased to welcome Farnell as an authorized distributor for the DEUTSCH connector and contact portfolio across Europe,” said **Kevin Beals, Senior Director Channel Sales, at TE Connectivity** .


“Farnell's strong distribution network and customer-focused approach will help expand access to DEUTSCH connector and contact solutions across key industrial and transportation markets. Together, we can better support customers who depend on reliable, high-performance connectivity while creating new opportunities for growth across the region.”
